failure_modes: Affinity is primary but decoded final affinity is unobserved (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so no affinity improvement can be claimed from this evidence; only selection-preference/coordinate response is testable.

The curve is non-monotone with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 batches and the quadratic fit is rejected (relative_node_RMSE 0.78), so a single signed direction or absolute coordinate target is not justified; the staged blend may not produce a consistent coordinate response.

Component gradients from the observed-forecast and static-teacher terms may cancel, leaving a changed scalar reward without a changed injection direction; distinguishing cancellation from an unsuitable target requires gradient-direction and delivered-dose checks, since a changing scalar value alone does not prove changed injection.
Only one of 200 curve features was inspected, so the recipe is justified by a single coordinate proxy and may not generalize across the full observed selection window.
Stage and temporal profiles are unavailable, so no stage boundary is discovered; the phase knot at 0.5 is an experimental hypothesis, not a data-derived stage.
Strain and structural validity are secondary and unmeasured here; a coordinate response could accompany unchanged or worsened strain/validity, which must be reported separately.
result.rationale: H001 is a supported temporal coordinate candidate: landmark_00_local_dx shows a large interior excursion (positive early near t~0.10-0.11, negative mid-window near t~0.19, near-zero late) with strong per-node rate contrasts at both ends of the observed window, and the observed score clock [0.0,0.49] lies inside the learning window [0.0,0.5]. This non-stationary, early-positive-to-mid-negative structure with late return toward zero is a time-dependent contrast, so a staged reward that weights same-clock historical forecasts early and smoothly approaches frozen static teachers late (S1_observed_to_static) is the registered reward-route recipe that matches the observed temporal relevance ordering. Dose is held fixed (dose_factors=1, route=reward), delta and temperatures are unchanged, and the schedule is normalized over actual observed score nodes with no extrapolation. S2_constant_blend and S3_static_to_observed_control are retained as the constant-blend and time-order controls needed to attribute any benefit to timing rather than to blending per se.
